task.title: Repair stale Compose replacement-container conflicts in dev root deployment

scope.owned_layer: Narrow stale Compose replacement-container detection and cleanup before dev root and bff compose rollout, preventing container recreation name conflicts without broad prune
not_changing: Never removes running or restarting containers (checked via state not in {running, restarting} and status not matching Up* or Restarting*)
Never removes containers belonging to other projects (filtered strictly to com.docker.compose.project=pantheon)
Never removes normal stopped pantheon containers lacking hash replacement prefixes
Source Ingestion reconcile-only default posture with no continuous external provider pull
Release admission and rollback behavior remain fail-closed with no live-capital writes

behavioral_proof.stale_replacement_container_detection: Detects only non-running and non-restarting containers (state != running, state != restarting, and status not starting with Up or Restarting) with label com.docker.compose.project=pantheon whose names match hex hash prefixes followed by _pantheon or -pantheon (e.g. 1234567890ab_pantheon-operator-bff-1, d20e73e97086_pantheon_postgres_1).
behavioral_proof.running_and_other_project_protection: Running containers, restarting containers, normal stopped pantheon containers (e.g. pantheon-postgres-1), other project containers, and unlabelled containers are completely untouched.
behavioral_proof.invoked_before_rollout: cleanup_stale_compose_replacement_containers is called in Phase 3 prior to docker compose up rollout in dev root deployment and bff recreation.
behavioral_proof.contract_tests: Executable positive tests verify removal of stale replacement containers across exited, dead, and created states; executable negative tests verify running replacement containers, restarting replacement containers, normal stopped containers, running normal containers, and other project containers are preserved intact.

review.reviewer_instruction: Bind this already-committed manifest with AI_NAME=Codex2 REVIEW_FILE=docs/deployment/evidence/product-functional-closure/OPS-DEPLOY-COMPOSE-STALE-CONTAINER-20260825/evidence.json through the governed approve command only after independently checking the exact PR head.
